messages.content:
Solve the given optimization problem and report the optimal objective value.
Do not use external tools or execute code.
If you can justify an integer optimum, write exactly 'Answer: <signed integer>' on the final nonempty line, without commas, units, decimals, or Markdown.
Do not round or truncate a noninteger optimum to fit this format. If you cannot justify an integer optimum, state that instead.
